_comment: Canonical transportation price facts. THE one place to update when the monthly freshness-check email flags a change. Consumed by src/lib/facts/prices.ts (site code) and scripts/build-micro-guides-migration.mjs (guide bodies — regenerate + apply the reseed migration after editing). Verified against the freshness_snapshots scrape.

mbta._transferPilot: Sept 1, 2026 for six months: unlimited subway/bus/ferry transfers within 2 hours on one card or phone, pay the highest single fare (https://www.mbta.com/fares/transfers). transferPilotEnds = first day it no longer applies; update if the MBTA extends or makes it permanent.
mbta._answerPagesSources: Reduced fares: mbta.com/fares/reduced; commuter rail monthly passes (CharlieTicket): mbta.com/fares/commuter-rail-fares/zones. Read 2026-10-16.

bluebikes._incomeEligibleSource: bluebikes.com/pricing, read 2026-10-16: $5 a month or $50 a year.

driving._parkingDailyBostonNote: parkingDailyBoston is a Boston-metro average (SpotAngels) used by the cost calculators. For downtown garages use parking.bostonCommonDay to parking.prudentialDay.
driving._answerPagesSources: AAA Your Driving Costs 2026 fact sheet (own and operate a new car, 15,000 mi/yr; fixed = depreciation 4,422 + insurance 2,098 + finance 1,184); excise mass.gov DLS; registration mass.gov RMV fees; inspection mass.gov; Cambridge permit cambridgema.gov/rpp ($75 from Dec 1, 2026); Zipcar Standard plan zipcar.com/pricing. Read 2026-10-16.

effort._comment: Shared by both Commute Advisors (public and employer). MET values from the ACSM compendium; speeds are typical urban door-to-door.

parking._comment: Posted rates read 2026-10-16. Garages: massconvention.com (Boston Common Garage, weekday 3-10 hrs and weekday monthly), posquare.com (full weekday), prudentialcenter.com (2-24 hrs). MBTA: mbta.com/parking/stations-and-rates. Meters and fines: boston.gov parking clerk. Tax: IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32; mass.gov commuter deduction. Schools: bu.edu, simmons.edu, umb.edu transportation pages.
